text:
The discussed climate-related reforms and RSF measures include:
- **RM2:** Approving draft building legislation integrating climate adaptation and mitigation [C115], [C223].
- **RM4:** Implementing climate budget tagging and fiscal sustainability analysis under climate scenarios [C113], [C031].
- **RM5 & RM10:** Adopting a national climate finance mobilization strategy, developing project pipelines, and securing project funding [C113], [C115], [C130], [C132].
- **RM6, RM6.1, RM9, & RM9.1:** CBS guidelines, supervisory frameworks, and risk exposure assessments for climate-related financial risks [C113], [C031], [C132].
- **RM7:** Adopting a national Disaster Risk Financing Strategy [C115], [C223].
- **RM8:** Scaling up renewable energy via regulatory frameworks and tariffs [C115], [C223].
- **RM11:** Introducing green fiscal and tax incentives [C223].
